$source: Amtrak IA App Shell Overview (PDF, 12 slides)
principle: One structure for the whole journey. Four primary destinations give features clear homes; the experience adapts to where the traveler is in their journey. The starting destination changes while the navigation stays the same.

globalHeader.purpose: Access to personal information and messages, on every tab.

items.label: Account
content: Profile + Guest Rewards card (tier, points, $ value, progress)
Quick settings: Trip updates, Sign in with Face ID, Dark Mode

items.label: Notification Inbox
content: Unread count + Mark all as read
items.note: Trip-relevant updates also appear alongside the trip they affect.

primaryNavigation.label: Book
primaryNavigation.job: A clear place to plan and purchase
content: Prominent 'New Booking · Where to?' entry → focused booking sheet (One-way/Round-trip, From/To, Popular stations, Depart, Travelers, Search trains, Recent)
Explore destinations: Recommended trips, Routes near me / favorite stations
Plan your trip: Explore, Passes, Gift cards
Offers, coupons and points pricing while planning

primaryNavigation.label: Trips
primaryNavigation.job: Everything connected to a booked journey
content: eTicket (QR, car/seat, Add to Wallet, live status, Track)
This trip: boarding, changes, rebook, onboard info, disruption guidance, trip-specific support

primaryNavigation.label: Train Status
content: Look up by Train number or Route

primaryNavigation.label: Support
primaryNavigation.job: A clear route to help and recovery
content: Guidance for you: Know-before-booking, Your station
Contact Amtrak: Text, Call, Email, Live Chat

landing.label: Active trip
landing.priority: Ticket, live information and immediate actions

journeyStages.label: Pre-departure
journeyStages.focus: Prepare, review trip details, get ready to leave for the station

journeyStages.label: Station
journeyStages.focus: Ticket, station information and boarding guidance

journeyStages.label: Onboard
journeyStages.focus: Train progress, onboard details and services

journeyStages.label: Arrival
journeyStages.focus: Arrival information and the transition out of the journey

platforms.iphone: Global header at top; Liquid Glass tab bar at bottom with the four destinations, Type=Default (no separate search: search lives in Book).
platforms.ipad: Glass tab bar centered at top with sidebar toggle and the four destinations; Account and Inbox at the trailing edge.
